title: add-pass counts the items already in the pass
lead: `slicer prose add-pass KEY` says how many items already sit in the pass it declares, instead of always saying "no items yet".
findings_note: dogfooding 2026-10-16: add-pass said no items yet with s312 already in v1.14
boundary: **Not in this slice:** declaring a pass automatically from `set --pass` or `add --pass`; the warning text of `set`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: On 2026-10-16 `slicer set s312 --pass v1.14` warned that v1.14 was not declared and suggested `slicer prose add-pass v1.14 --after <pass>`. Following that hint printed `created pass v1.14 (no items yet); file items with slicer add --pass v1.14`, but s312 was already in it. The text is a fixed string (`cmd_prose_add_pass`, `src/slicer/cli.py:2784`), so it is wrong exactly on the path slicer's own warning recommends.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py`, `cmd_prose_add_pass`: count `state.index.items` whose `pass_key` is the new key. With none, keep today's line. With some, print `created pass KEY for N existing item(s)`, without the "file items with" hint. The JSON payload is unchanged.
- `CHANGELOG.md` under Fixed.
- `tests/test_prose.py`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_AddPass_ItemsAlreadyInPass_TextCountsThem`: after `set S1 --pass vX`, `prose add-pass vX` prints `for 1 existing item(s)` and not `no items yet`.
- `test_AddPass_NoItems_TextUnchanged`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch the first go red.
2. Count and branch the text; mutation-check (always print the old line).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
